column1: Verify the Phase 42A.6 scenario engine operates correctly in production.
- [ ] Scenarios created for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY based on market conditions
- [ ] Activation timestamp ≥ all input timestamps (no look-ahead)
- [ ] Each activation has: completed 5m candle + scenario trigger + confirmation + invalidation
- [ ] No forced scenarios — system may produce WAIT/NO TRADE/NO CLEAR INTENT
- [ ] Which scenarios activate? (depends on actual market conditions)
- [ ] Do any scenarios reach ACTIVATED/CONFIRMED? (depends on market)
- [ ] Is look-ahead protection maintained? (ALL inputs ≤ activation time)
